name: loyalty-stamp-card
title: Loyalty Stamp Card
description: A shop's stamp card with 8 to 10 slots: stamps press in one by one, a counter ticks up, and the last slot opens to the reward ("GRATIS 1"). The slot count, how many are filled and the reward text are variables.
useWhen: Telling regulars about a stamp or points card ("beli 9, yang ke-10 gratis").
A small shop's loyalty programme in a short promo.
avoidWhen: A discount code to hand out: use voucher-ticket.
A one-time sale price: use price-drop.
author: Mosio

source.technique: stamp and punch: a run of hard, short stamps landing one by one, then a pop-in payoff

variables.label: Card title
variables.description: Small label next to the shop name.

variables.label: Slots
variables.description: Number of slots on the card, the last one is the reward.

variables.label: Stamps filled
variables.description: How many stamps get pressed in. When this reaches slots minus one, the last slot opens to the reward.

variables.label: Reward text
variables.description: Text revealed in the last slot.

variables.label: Note
variables.description: One line under the card. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: The reward slot: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
